title: Identify an activity subplugin and its parent contract
setup: A developer has a local checkout of the Moodle 5.3 BigBlueButton activity and one nested subplugin.
prompt: Explain where a new sibling subplugin belongs and which files determine its plugin type.
checks: Identify the activity parent and read its db/subplugins.json.
Distinguish the target branch's metadata keys and relative paths.
Use an existing sibling and the official plugin metadata guide to verify the location.
